summary: Frontend-only test of the change that closes upload pop-ups automatically, plus an audit of other pop-ups. All 4 bulk upload pop-ups behave as specified. A clean upload closes the pop-up and reopening it shows an empty state. An upload with duplicate or error rows keeps the pop-up open and lists them. Leads: 2 new rows closed the pop-up; 1 new + 1 duplicate kept it open with leads-bulk-result and leads-bulk-duplicates. Colleges: same with bulk-result ('1 duplicate(s) skipped — e.g. ...'). Students: clean apply closed it; 1 valid + 1 error row ('name is required') stayed open showing '✓ Applied' with the error row. Attendance: 'Choose CSV file' (bulk-file-input) still loads the file into bulk-csv; clean apply closed it; a row with 'staff not found' stayed open. Clients regression: client-import-review-dialog closes after client-import-confirm and the new client appears in the list. Spot checks in the UI: the Clients add form, the College form (college-dialog) and the Lead add form (lead-form-dialog) all close after saving. A code audit of about 50 pop-up save handlers found only one pop-up that stays open after a successful save (CampaignDistributeDialog). One minor issue: after a manual close, Attendance and Students bulk pop-ups keep their old content.

ui_bugs.issue: Closing manually (footer Close, X or Escape) does not reset the pop-up. It uses <Dialog onOpenChange={onOpenChange}> and the Close button calls onOpenChange(false), not close(). Reopening shows the old CSV text and the old preview with '✓ Applied'. Reproduced in the browser. Auto-close after a clean apply does reset correctly.
The footer Close button calls onOpenChange(false) directly. This skips the Dialog's reset handler, so reopening shows the old CSV text (reproduced in the browser). X and Escape reset correctly.

design_issues.screen: All bulk upload pop-ups / CRUD saves
issues: The sonner success toasts (e.g., 'Imported N lead(s)') never appear. lib/celebrate.js replaces them with a generic 'Saved successfully!' overlay (already known from iteration 20). On a partial upload the user only sees the result panel, not the toast text.

audit_popups_staying_open_after_success.behavior: After a successful distribute it calls setResult(data), shows a toast and calls onDistributed(), but never calls onOpenChange(false). The pop-up stays open showing distribute-result. Found in code review, not run in the UI.
Save works row by row and the pop-up stays open. This looks intentional for editing several days; flagged for awareness only.
Inline actions (status note, visit, follow-up, campaign change) keep the detail view open. This looks intentional for a detail/workspace view.

action_items: CampaignDistributeDialog: after a successful distribute, close the pop-up automatically if no rows were skipped, to match the new rule.
Attendance BulkUploadDialog: pass a handler like (v) => v ? onOpenChange(true) : close() to the Dialog and make the footer Close call close(), so a manual close also resets csv and preview.
StudentBulkUploadDialog: the footer Close button should also clear csv and preview (setCsv(''); reset()).
critical_code_review_comments: In the Attendance and Students bulk pop-ups the file input is never reset after a file is loaded. Choosing the same file again does not fire onChange.
The Clients add/edit DialogContent (pages/Clients.jsx line 290) has no data-testid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (7/7); 2 low-priority reset issues on manual close
